description: Deterministic policy classifying Job Fit gate assessments and dimension assessments (human_judgment_questions) into automation outcomes: AUTO_PROCEED, AUTO_PROCEED_WITH_GAPS, AUTO_OMIT, AUTO_REJECT, REQUIRE_USER, NOT_APPLICABLE. Consumes Job Fit v1 results already produced by product/semantic_job_fit.py; does not recompute gate status, dimension coverage, matches, evidence_disposition, or materiality. Gate classification is driven directly by the assessment's own evidence_disposition (SUPPORTIVE | CONFLICTING | ABSENT | INSUFFICIENT) and materiality (MATERIAL | NON_MATERIAL | NOT_APPLICABLE) fields, both produced upstream by semantic_job_fit.py's _build_gate_assessments -- this policy does not infer support from evidence-id presence alone. materiality is resolved per assessment from whether the specific posting's own job evidence contains an item in the gate's category; it is never a static default keyed only on gate type, since any gate category (including language) can be material for one posting and inapplicable for another.

reason_codes.gate_fail_supported: Gate failed with trustworthy, supported disqualifying evidence.
reason_codes.gate_flag: Gate proposal raised an explicit caveat requiring human review.
reason_codes.gate_not_applicable: This posting asserts no requirement in this gate's evidence category; there is nothing to evaluate for or against.
reason_codes.gate_material_supportive: This posting asserts a material requirement in this gate's category, and validated, non-conflicted candidate evidence affirmatively supports it.
reason_codes.gate_material_conflicting: This posting asserts a material requirement in this gate's category, and candidate evidence conflicts with it; never safe to silently resolve.
reason_codes.gate_material_absent: This posting asserts a material requirement in this gate's category, and no candidate evidence addresses it; a missing answer to a material question requires the candidate.
reason_codes.gate_material_insufficient: This posting asserts a material requirement in this gate's category, and the available evidence was never validated toward a verdict; escalating rather than assuming support.
reason_codes.gate_non_material_supportive: This posting's requirement in this gate's category is non-material, and validated candidate evidence affirmatively supports it anyway.
reason_codes.gate_non_material_conflicting: Candidate evidence conflicts with this gate's category; conflicting evidence is never safe to silently omit, even when the gate is non-material.
reason_codes.gate_non_material_absent: This posting's requirement in this gate's category is non-material and no candidate evidence addresses it; omitting is safe.
reason_codes.gate_non_material_insufficient: This posting's requirement in this gate's category is non-material, but the available evidence was never validated toward a verdict; escalating rather than assuming safety to omit.
reason_codes.dimension_ready: All relevant job requirements/responsibilities for this dimension were matched at or above the required coverage ratio.
reason_codes.dimension_no_relevant_job_ids: This dimension has no job-side requirements or responsibilities to evaluate against; there is no evaluable signal for or against it on this posting.
reason_codes.dimension_partial_coverage: Some relevant job requirements/responsibilities were matched with supported evidence; the remainder are recorded as gaps and must not be claimed as supported.
reason_codes.dimension_zero_coverage: None of the relevant job requirements/responsibilities for this required dimension were matched; this is a material fit question.
